about: Host rulings that apply to every school (a per-school host is a [[hosts]] entry in schools/<key>.toml and its hosts.json). Owner rulings are dated.

hosts.scope: profile search and profile read only (POST /login once, GET /profiles/search?term=<name>); no bulk export, no notes, no email fields kept
hosts.cache: every response cached on local disk (chmod 600); a request is never repeated
hosts.on_stop: stop for the day (state marker), no retry, no evasion, challenge URLs never opened
hosts.credentials: ~/.config/cs-atlas/openreview.env only (OPENREVIEW_USERNAME, OPENREVIEW_PASSWORD); never printed, logged or committed
hosts.account_note: The account is currently the owner's personal account; a dedicated project account is recommended.
hosts.ruling: Owner decision 2026-11-13 (repeated, confirmed 'go ahead, and lets please do it'): the OpenReview route is a standard part of the student search.

robots.consequence: the tool refuses any request URL containing email= (tools/openreview_students.guard_url); no email field is requested or kept

hosts.one_job_at_a_time: Spacing is enforced across processes by the lock file scratch/openreview-students/last-request; a worker that does not use it (the 2026-11-13 Stage B script) must not run alongside a tool job: one OpenReview job at a time.
hosts.rate_limit_history: 2026-11-13: HTTP 429 at ~20 req/min (pilot) and a SECOND 429 on the first search after a 32-minute idle (Stage B): the account/endpoint is throttled. Spacing raised 6 -> 10 s, budget 100 per run.
hosts.day_marker: the first 429/401/403/challenge writes scratch/openreview-students/STOPPED-<UTC date>; every later run (Slurm or manual) that could make a request refuses to start that UTC day (dry-run is still allowed).
hosts.third_429: A third HTTP 429 means the account is rate-capped: stop the route, contact OpenReview and read their Terms of Use before any further request; the owner decides.
